periods.time: vol-17 ch-005, three days after the war

name.zh: 一辉苏醒、珠雫升A级与史黛菈和解
name.en: Ikki wakes, Shizuku becomes A-rank, and Stella reconciles

periods.type: hospital aftermath / relationship reckoning / political setup
periods.summary: Ikki wakes in a Vermillion hospital three days after dying. Stella explains that Shizuku reconstructed him at the cellular level and that the war is over. Ikki learns Quedland is stabilizing under John and Lunaeyes, Nene can restore her arm, and Tatara survived but is gravely damaged. He then learns Shizuku used her own cells to replace missing tissue, temporarily fusing with him and leaving him child-sized when she separates; Shizuku estimates he can regain his adult body in about six months. Nene arrives with notice that Shizuku has been promoted to A-rank for overturning death, and relays Levi Ascaride's message thanking Ikki for letting Alice die without regret and promising one unconditional personal favor. Nene warns Ikki that his victory over Alice makes him a League main-force knight and political allies will matter. Before leaving, Shizuku coldly rebukes Ikki for choosing a death-premised plan after promising Stella love. Stella then locks the room, admits she had been furious, and Ikki apologizes without hiding behind tactics. They agree to grow stronger together and reaffirm their relationship with a kiss, only for Sirius and Astrea to interrupt with urgent news about Tatara's departure.
periods.cause: Shizuku's Water World revives Ikki and the survivors must process the personal, medical and political aftermath of the war.
periods.outcome: Ikki survives in a temporary child body; Shizuku becomes A-rank; Ikki accepts Levi's future support; Stella and Ikki reconcile and set a new shared resolve.
casualties: ikki-kurogane temporarily reduced to child body and diminished physical capacity
periods.significance: Converts the miracle of revival into lasting character consequences and foreshadows Ikki's new political importance after becoming Sword God.
